We got a kit to make a kite. We cut out a cute cub with a cap and cape. But a cut in the kite made us mad. We put the kite on a cube and use a tube of glue. We add tape, tap it flat, and hope our kite will fly. We hop up and hug as our huge kite flies high! Conseguimos un kit para hacer una cometa. Recortamos un lindo cachorro con una gorra y una capa.
